rules.decision: Existing fact perception and witness semantics remain byte-for-byte preserved. Shared, exact Members inclusion and Host omission determine fact visibility; native witness admission additionally binds actual canonical observer/source/time/accepted fact/member-character and route.
rules.authority: planning/interaction-engine.md Persistent social and epistemic model (CanonicalFact, KnowledgeGrant, WitnessRecord); planning/runtime-directors.md Authority and composition / Pure public boundaries; current witness.rs and perception.rs
rules.interpretation: Already implemented current fact boundary; proposal does not invent contact, disclosure mechanics or auth

rules.decision: A claim must pass its own current AttributedClaim.audience before selection. A named SecretPolicy may narrow, never widen, the exact claim's audience.
rules.authority: planning/interaction-engine.md Persistent social and epistemic model: Belief is an attributed claim; SecretPolicy specifies owner/permitted knowledge; planning/subsystem-interfaces.md Identity and session ownership requires current audience revalidation.
rules.interpretation: Proposed concrete intersection of two canonical explicit audience fields; Root admission required

rules.decision: SecretPolicy.claims links exact RecordIds; its holder must match claim.holder and containing NpcState.entity. Any mismatched ownership or more than one matching policy suppresses only that claim.
rules.authority: planning/interaction-engine.md Persistent social and epistemic model explicitly assigns a secret owner; current model SecretPolicy has holder+claims+policy+permitted_audience, NpcState owns secrets, AttributedClaim has holder.
rules.interpretation: Proposed conservative consistency rule, not an existing checkpoint invariant or a literal prescribed duplicate-policy rule. Root must freeze this choice. Suppression preserves canonical records and safe error shape.

rules.decision: A selected full canonical claim may not return an evidence FactId whose current GameFact audience denies this observer. Fact audiences and canonical truth are unchanged.
rules.authority: planning/interaction-engine.md Grounded creative speech and listener-safe generation forbids unauthorized facts/text/raw secret IDs in listener contexts; planning/client-architecture.md server filtering precedes sending; existing perceive fact visibility.
rules.interpretation: One-way safety of a full AttributedClaim borrow carrying evidence IDs. This does not assert all domain claim knowledge requires knowing its evidence. A heard rumor with private origin needs a separate actual redacted public speech record.

rules.decision: A private or false claim citing a public fact never narrows that fact's audience. No KnowledgeGrant, relationship, confidence, evidence link or text broadens fact or claim permission.
rules.authority: planning/interaction-engine.md: NPC may lie/misunderstand/conceal without mutating truth; claims and canonical facts separate. planning/long-horizon-state.md Retrieval and contradiction semantics: beliefs retain contradictory claims and false beliefs; canonical truth from committed facts.
rules.interpretation: Prevents unsupported old -01 claim-to-fact policy inference

rules.decision: Existing legitimate multi-source grants and duplicate witness no-op remain valid; this proposal changes no global KnowledgeGrant semantics.
rules.authority: Current KnowledgeGrant has observer+fact+source; checkpoint validates referenced facts but imposes neither source==fact nor global observer/fact uniqueness; witness.rs creates its own accepted witnessed fact as both fact/source.

rules.decision: Selection binds exact current basis, content/rules/build pins and trusted ObserverScope; finite shared scan/comparison/output bounds fail atomically with no returned partial selection. It preserves checkpoint ordering and borrowed record identity.
rules.authority: planning/runtime-directors.md Pure public boundaries; planning/long-horizon-state.md current observer/source/access revalidation; planning/coding-style.md bounded ownership and typed errors.
rules.interpretation: Pure native canonical selection only; owner must revalidate separately before later publication
